evidence: The growth rate and the thickness uniformity have been studied, along with Auger depth profiling and Rutherford back scattering (RBS), to ascertain the quality of the films. The chemical compositions of the prepared samples were determined by Auger depth profile (AES) and Rutherford back scattering (RBS). The XPS analysis of Al2O3 films grown revealed only an oxidized Al 2p peak. The thickness and the uniformity of the films were measured by an ellipsometer. A cross-sectional scanning electron micrograph of the prepared specimen has been shown.
